vacancy.title: Space Safety Functional and Validation Architect
vacancy.assessment: Direct ESA/ESTEC A2-A4 role for Space Safety missions (Aurora, ADR/IOS) coordinating spacecraft AIT/AIV, environmental test campaigns, integration, procurement, production and robotic/GNC validation. Broad mechanical/test/project engineering overlap, but ESA explicitly requires more than ten years of hands-on spacecraft development and major verification/validation leadership, making this a substantial seniority and space-domain stretch.
